tui.busy_delivery.queue_notice.note: Shown when a message sent to a working turn is queued without interrupting: it waits for this step and the tools keep running. Same rendered height as both_notice and the classic queued notice across 20-90 columns.

tui.busy_delivery.both_notice.note: Shown when a message sent to a working turn is queued and escalates to a steer if it waits too long: it waits now and the tools keep running. Deliberately identical to queue_notice — the height contract keeps the settle from reflowing the transcript.
